episode_title: Mastering Stress and Leadership in Business | Redefine Growth # 19

real_qa.q: How does The Boost Company apply behavioral psychology and military training to corporate leadership development?
real_qa.r: The Boost Company combines military air force pilot training with behavioral psychology foundations to train people in handling stress and uncomfortable situations. Instead of traditional classroom-based PowerPoint training where 95% of content is forgotten, the company creates complete experiential programs including mission planning exercises, briefings with controlled stress and panic scenarios, and emotional moments that trigger memory formation in the brain.
real_qa.requete: Boost Company behavioral psychology military training leadership

real_qa.q: What is the difference between reaction and response in receiving and giving feedback according to combat helicopter pilot training?
real_qa.r: Reaction occurs when you do not know your filters and emotions, causing you to react immediately on feeling. Response requires knowing your behavioral filters and how you act, allowing you to respond with more ease and effectiveness. You must know your behavioral insights from yourself first before you can give feedback to others; if you react immediately to criticism, you are not ready to give feedback.
real_qa.requete: reaction versus response feedback behavioral psychology
